items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 18 September 2026 6:18am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Gales.


##Wind)##

West or SW 4 or 5, gradually increasing Southwest 6 or 7 through this morning and occasionally gale 8 in the afternoon to east of island. Becoming SW 6 occasionally 7 in the evening, then West or SW 5 or 6 later tonight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, building moderate or rough.


##Weather)##

Rain spreading from the west, turning patchy later in day then clearing tonight.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
